title: Archive complete verification keys and negative 15% cost screen
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A complete capture of all 2,579,750 contribution keys from the frozen PR5864 qualifier closes the actual-data gap in the earlier synthetic key pilot. Every ordered opaque ID, hit/miss/eviction flag and 80-operation/final prefix agrees with an independent Python dict/deque oracle in all four fixed BCCB key-only samples. The scoped audit passes; its performance nomination fails.

The smaller paired actual-key saving is 0.160740552 wall / 0.160850468 CPU seconds. Adding the earlier integer gross-region anchor, while assigning zero retained integer runtime and zero new bill, gives 4.845453128 / 4.844279183 seconds, below the fixed 5.199267809 / 5.1705 second planning thresholds. This conditional cross-run screen is neither a measured complete saving nor a universal upper bound. The further 15% complete PR5864 target remains unmet. No production integration, κ or selected-frontier change is proposed.

The package retains the complete compressed key corpus, one lossless canonical copy of all ordered outputs, hashes for all five original output sets, exact measured sources, source-only reviews and raw bounded diagnostic receipts. Standalone finite/data/context verifiers authenticate those artifacts without replacing the historical performance gate.

## Task and overlap

Base: `19fdb086ea96af9a9f87936a2b888e10af4ed810`. Publication head: `1018e3751fce3aacf99a5dbdc05d387fb63b6672`. Scope: refined `replay-runtime` / bounded actual-key headroom audit. The original card and selected record remain pinned historical provenance. The five data inputs were separately committed at `f901e992a3846ff0351bfb0caf75b6167788cd74`; the official PR5864 archive is the existing declared repository input.

This follows [PR5908](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5908), which assesses four C opportunities. [PR5864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5864) supplies the frozen qualifier; [PR5875](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5875) is the separate negative score-dispatch pilot. [PR5929](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5929) has a separate H25 complex-side verification segment result and supplies no percentage to this PR5864 gate.

Adjacent memoization precedents include [PR2506](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2506) (P104 binary matrix-vector cache) and [PR4947](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4947) (source-bound exact inverse reuse). They cover different workloads; their author-reported timings were not replayed here. A bounded exact-phrase open-PR query is not exhaustive novelty evidence.

## Validation

Linux 64-bit CPython 3.12.3 local checks pass from a Git-free copy with source files 0444 and directories 0555:

- `python3.12 -B research/verification-key-headroom/verify.py finite` and the same with `-O`: fresh unchanged C comparator, 82 finite receipts and 50 natural rehashes each, clean compiler logs.
- `verify.py data`: every one of 2,579,750 keys, all ordered IDs/flags and 32,247 prefixes compared with the independent literal oracle, complete payload hashes and exact counters.
- `verify.py context`: exact 164-file baseline / 177-file measured-stage reconstruction, original C inversion, reference pins and official PR5864 export equality.

Metadata/pins, separate Astra source review, committed-byte/source-history preflight and the 276-file committed export with all six declared inputs pass. All 252 protected source/data/metadata files equal the tested copy; source manifest SHA-256 is `9b3c05b97f926c2c767ad394a399554cd4034a86526dead247251e0921c697d5`. Local receipts are in the package's `publication/`; `VALIDATION.json` records the local publication state before hosted execution. Exact-head [run40542719102](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40542719102) now passes676 shared tests/22 skips and all four registered package commands on CPython3.12.15. Every key/ID/flag/prefix and exact context passed; tracked/index diffs are clean. Hosted success is scoped correctness/transport evidence, not a new performance sample. [Final seven-field handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5972#issuecomment-6447761029).

The original complete capture/replay finished in 42.639824143 wall / 42.54 CPU seconds with sampled process-group RSS 437,825,536 bytes under 180-second / 1-GiB limits. It retained 120 finite fixtures, all 25,984 actual events / 799 coordinates, complete signed witnesses, source bytes/modes and original cache statistics. The key comparator passed 82 finite controls and all four full-output comparisons. This outer diagnostic bill is not a complete performance sample.

No new full capture or timing reroll was performed for publication. Optional capture reproduction is not registered for CI. Original Fraction arithmetic and ordered score operations remain unchanged in the measured capture. Both key-only arms exclude Fraction arithmetic, descriptor extraction, callback validation, score updates and full qualification. Hosted success cannot establish the local performance interpretation.

## Credit

Retains inherited P104/source authors and Apache-2.0 notices, Ali Romman and PR5848/5864 predecessor credit, plus PR5908/5875 lineage. PR2506 credits Chafik Boukhalfa, Ali Romman and Rohan Arun; PR4947 is by JoyboyBrian. Prepared for Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and Astra xhigh design plus separate source review; the parent alone executed guarded science. No independent correctness, C memory-safety, theorem or κ certification is claimed.

## Open next questions

See the package README/TASK questions. A continuation requires a materially different source-pinned mechanism, exact ownership/arithmetic/return/witness contracts and credible wall and CPU headroom after retained work and the complete new bill. More favorable repetitions, GMP provisioning or full integration of this failed nomination are not justified by these receipts.
